def cake_moe_expert_selection(routing_logits, routing_bias, selected_groups, out=None):

        (routing_logits, (1, 256), torch.float32),

        raise ValueError("every input must share one device")

    if tuple(out.shape) != (1, 8) or out.dtype != torch.int32:
        raise ValueError("out differs from the frozen output contract")

        D_SELECTED_GROUPS_1=4,
        N_TOKEN=1,
        D_EXPERT_IDS_1=8,
        num_warps=4,
    )
    return out
